items.prompt: Day - landing lights ON in vicinity of airport
If roughness continues after one min:
If operation is satisfactory on either mag, continue on that magneto at reduced power and full "RICH" mixture to the nearest airport.
Land as soon as possible and investigate cause.
Land at the nearest airport and investigate the problem.
If ALT annunciator illuminates again or breaker pops a second time: turn ALT switch OFF, pull breaker, reduce electrical load and land as soon as practical.
Prepare to lose electrical power after 10-15 minutes.
If both upper and lower latches are open, the door will trail slightly open and airspeeds will be reduced slightly.
To close the door in flight:

items.expectation: OPEN TOP LATCH, PUSH DOOR FURTHER OPEN, CLOSE RAPIDLY, LATCH TOP

items.expectation: HIGHWAYS, GOLF COURSES, FIELDS, NEAR PUBLIC ACCESS

items.prompt: If no fire or engine seizure is suspected, attempt restart.
If unable to restart, continue with items D, E, G.
If sufficient runway remains for a normal landing, land straight ahead.
Maintain safe airspeed. Make only shallow turns to avoid obstructions. Flaps as the situation requires.
If sufficient altitude to attempt a restart:
If power is not regained, proceed with Power Off Landing.
If no fuel pressure is indicated, check tank selector position to be sure it is on a tank containing fuel.
If power is NOT restored, proceed with Power Off Landing.
Locate a suitable field. When field can easily be reached, slow to 66 KIAS (76 MPH) for shortest landing.
Upon extinguishing fire, proceed with ABC checklist. NO RESTART.
